hook: How is LeBron James connected to Kim Jong Un?
title: How is LeBron James connected to Kim Jong Un?
description: Three real photos connect LeBron James to North Korea's Kim Jong Un, through two American presidents.

image.file: File:Barack Obama shaking hands with LeBron James, July 2012.jpg

links.line: In 2012, LeBron James shook hands with President Obama.

image.file: File:Obama hands over presidency to Trump at 58th Presidential Inauguration 170120-D-NA975-0947.jpg

links.line: In 2017, Obama handed the presidency to Donald Trump.

image.file: File:President Trump Meets with Chairman Kim Jong Un (48162628746).jpg

links.line: And in 2019, Trump shook hands with Kim Jong Un at the Korean border.
